headline: China mandates 70% homegrown silicon wafer use, accelerating tech decoupling for AI chip supply.
summary: Beijing's new directive for 70% domestic silicon wafer sourcing aims to localize its critical chip supply chain amid the AI boom and ongoing export restrictions, signaling an intensified push for self-sufficiency. This move will further fragment the global semiconductor industry, increasing geopolitical tensions and forcing major supply chain adjustments for both Chinese and international tech firms.
